facts.fact: Austrian company OeSD International (called Austrian State Printing House) is party to a signed public-private partnership for Liberia's national ID and civil registration upgrade, described as about US$54 million, still needing parliamentary approval; NIR says so; as_of is the 2026-09-14 publication date, as no signing date is given.
